product.name: Bug Tracker
product.tagline: Where engineering teams squash bugs 10x faster
product.short_description: The lightning-fast, developer-first defect tracking and sprint intelligence SaaS built with Next.js 16 and Turbopack.
product.long_description: Bug Tracker is a modern, high-performance engineering management and defect-tracking SaaS built with Next.js 16 (Turbopack, App Router), React 19, Auth.js (NextAuth v5), Prisma ORM, and Tailwind CSS. It combines the speed, keyboard-first navigation (⌘K), and minimalism of Linear with the technical defect-triage depth of Jira (reproducible defect schemas, stack trace tagging, environment badging, and automated SLA compliance timers). Features interactive OpenAPI 3.0.3 documentation with live Stoplight Elements explorer, real-time Agile sprint burndown charts, multi-tenant RBAC, and 1-click Docker Compose self-hosting.
product.price_starting: Free (Paid plans starting at $12/month for teams)
